metadata.name: Measure candidate15 suffix drafting on counting and prose

comparison_scope: Same candidate binary, weights, threads, greedy sampler and real browser adapter; explicit suffix off/on.
timing_scope: Fresh-prefix request wall time including reset, mode, prefill, suffix proposal/IPC and text decoding. Startup and symmetric warmups excluded.
limitations: 64 is a natural-EOS output cap, not a forced length. Exact IDs/text/EOS must match on every warmup and scored request.
One process per visit, with reuse_prefix=False. No prefix priming or retained-prefix benefit.
Wasted verified positions counts computed verification rows whose input was not committed; not a wall-time attribution.
OS scheduling/background activity remain uncontrolled. No inferred llama, full-model quality, or combined-workload win.

correctness_scope: Exact visible IDs, text and natural stop/cap through the real adapter; fixed nine and eighteen case suites plus repetitive/budget fixtures. Not an independent model-quality claim.

messages.content: Count from 1 to 40, separated by commas, without commentary.
Explain memory bandwidth and caching in four concise sentences.

low-repetition.text: Memory bandwidth refers to the speed at which data can be transferred between the CPU and main memory. Caching is a technique that stores frequently used data in a temporary memory to reduce the need for more expensive memory access. Both concepts work together to improve performance by minimizing the time the CPU spends waiting for data to be retrieved from

bootstrap.method: Paired percentile bootstrap of median speedup; same round indices for every metric/profile

analysis.limitation: Unadjusted separate workload intervals; no pooled or cross-workload speedup.

archive_provenance.sanitization: Home/repository paths and process IDs/names removed; host CPU percentages retained from ps column index2. Raw artifact hashes preserved.
archive_provenance.compaction: All scored pair metrics, ratios, uncertainty and work counters retained. Repeated IDs/text stored once in expected_outputs; identical warmup trajectories checked against expected before archiving, with warmup counts retained and unscored timing omitted. Redundant adapter_metrics omitted.
